verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing docs mention 'transaction rules' that automatically approve or decline authorizations based on business requirements, and relayed authorization webhooks that let you apply custom real-time logic at authorization time — both are plausible mechanisms for MCC and merchant-based spend controls. However, no evidence explicitly confirms MCC allowlist/blocklist configuration or single-merchant lock functionality. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCC allowlist/blocklist rule types, explicit single-merchant lock capability, and any hands-on confirmation these specific restrictions work at authorization time.
